ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels covering approximately 90% of the surface area with a high-contrast low-intensity (black) margin along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white field across the interior lobes. Dark pigmentation is restricted to the trailing edge boundary and a localized dark patch on the distal tip of the left lobe. A discrete circular low-intensity spot is visible in the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a visible sharp vertex; approximate 55-degree aperture.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Right lobe contains a prominent, high-amplitude traumatic excision (deep jagged notch) approximately one-third of the way from the median notch, flanked by smaller irregular peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes follow a convex sweep from the notch to the tips; the right lobe is oriented at a higher vertical angle relative to the water line than the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A single distinct circular dark pixel cluster is present on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe. Several small, low-contrast brownish-yellow pixel clusters are visible on the interior of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular indentation and loss of fluke tissue on the trailing edge of the right lobe, resulting in a jagged, multi-pointed profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark circular 'target' spot on the left lobe ventral surface.
